name: std::weak_ptr<T>::reset
intro: Releases the reference to the managed object. After the call *this manages no object.

examples.output:
shared.use_count(): 3
weak.use_count(): 3
weak.expired(): false
weak.reset();
shared.use_count(): 3
weak.use_count(): 0
weak.expired(): true

summary: Releases the reference to the managed object. After the call *this manages no object.
